```{r shared-setup}
#| include: false
#| cache: false
source("scripts/analysis_setup.R")

# Sort key for bar charts: by share, with any "Other..." category last
# (Wilke ch. 6: order by value; a catch-all category is not part of that order).
other_last <- function(label, value) {
  label <- as.character(label)
  case_when(
    startsWith(label, "Other") | label == "Countries at <2%" ~ -Inf,
    label == "1 respondent" ~ -2,
    label == "2 respondents" ~ -1,
    TRUE ~ value
  )
}

format_category_labels <- function(labels) {
  lapply(
    labels,
    \(label) {
      if (identical(label, "Other")) {
        bquote(italic(.(label)))
      } else {
        label
      }
    }
  )
}
```

## Included sample: N = `r nrow(data)`

The analysis includes `r nrow(data)` respondents after applying the study's date and completion criteria.

```{r sample-summary}
tibble(
  respondents = nrow(data),
  mean_completion_minutes = mean(as.numeric(data$TIME_SUM), na.rm = TRUE) / 60,
  median_completion_minutes = median(as.numeric(data$TIME_SUM), na.rm = TRUE) / 60
) |>
  knitr::kable(
    format = "html",
    digits = c(0, 1, 1),
    col.names = c(
      "Respondents",
      "Mean completion time (minutes)",
      "Median completion time (minutes)"
    ),
    caption = "Summary of the included sample.",
    align = c("r", "r", "r"),
    table.attr = kable_table_attributes
  )
```

```{r}

n_total <- data %>%

data$A001 %>% table() %>%  data.frame() %>% dplyr::rename(level = !!names(.)[1]) %>%
    mutate(percent_score = round(Freq / sum(Freq) * 100)) %>% 
    mutate(level = factor(level, levels = rev(c("Beginner", "Intermediate", "Expert")))) %>% 
    ggplot(data = ., aes(y = level, x = percent_score)) +

 scale_x_continuous(
```

## Country of work

::: {.callout-note title="Respondents by country of work (table)" collapse="true"}
```{r}
country_responses <- data %>%
  transmute(
    country_work = case_when(
      A004 == "-2" & !is.na(A004s) & A004s != "" ~ A004s,
      TRUE ~ A004
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    country_work = trimws(country_work),
    country_work = case_when(
      country_work %in% c("NL", "Nl", "The Netherlands") ~ "Netherlands",
      country_work == "fr" ~ "France",
      country_work == "UK" ~ "United Kingdom",
      country_work %in% c("United States", "United States of America") ~ "USA",
      country_work %in% c(
        "Prefer not to say",
        "Professor",
        "Senior Researcher"
      ) ~ NA_character_,
      TRUE ~ country_work
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(country_work), country_work != "")

make_geography_plot <- function(summary_data, category, title,
                                respondent_total = sum(summary_data$Freq),
                                percent_formatter = \(x) paste0(round(x), "%")) {
  category <- rlang::enquo(category)
  summary_data <- summary_data %>%
    mutate(.percent_label = percent_formatter(percent_score))

  summary_data %>%
    ggplot(aes(percent_score, fct_reorder(!!category, other_last(!!category, percent_score)))) +
    geom_col(width = 0.7, fill = "#6BAED6") +
    geom_text(
      aes(label = .percent_label),
      hjust = -0.15,
      size = 6
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      "Percent of respondents",
      labels = \(x) paste0(x, "%"),
      sec.axis = sec_axis(
        ~ . * respondent_total / 100,
        name = "Number of respondents"
      ),
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))
    ) +
    scale_y_discrete(labels = format_category_labels) +
    labs(title = title, y = NULL) +
    coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
    theme_classic(base_family = "Lato", base_size = 20) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 22),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 20),
      axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
      plot.caption.position = "plot",
      plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0)
    )
}

country <- country_responses %>%
  mutate(
    country_work = fct_lump_min(
      factor(country_work),
      min = 2,
      other_level = "Other"
    )
  ) %>% count(country_work, name = "Freq") %>%
  mutate(
    percent_score = Freq / sum(Freq) * 100,
    country_work = fct_reorder(
      country_work,
      percent_score
    ),
    country_work = fct_recode(country_work, UK = "United Kingdom")
  )
country |>
  arrange(desc(Freq)) |>
  mutate(
    country_work = as.character(country_work),
    country_work = if_else(
      country_work == "Other",
      "<em>Other</em>",
      country_work
    ),
    percent_score = paste0(round(percent_score), "%")
  ) |>
  knitr::kable(
    format = "html",
    escape = FALSE,
    col.names = c(
      "Country of work",
      "Respondents",
      "Percent of respondents"
    ),
    caption = "Respondents by country of work.",
    align = c("l", "r", "r"),
    table.attr = kable_table_attributes
  )
```

### Below 2% grouped

```{r}
#| cache: false
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 4.8
# Country name followed by its flag (flags line up in a column at the axis).
# Flags: figures/flags/<iso2>.png from flagcdn.com, see figures/flags/SOURCES.md.
flag_tag <- function(iso, height = 11, width = 18) {
  flag_width <- if_else(!is.na(iso) & iso == "ch", height, width)
  sprintf(
    "<img src='%s' width='%d' height='%d'/>",
    project_path("figures", "flags", paste0(iso, ".png")),
    flag_width,
    height
  )
}

flag_label <- function(labels, height = 11, width = 18) {
  labels <- as.character(labels)
  display_labels <- if_else(labels == "United Kingdom", "UK", labels)
  other <- startsWith(labels, "Other")
  iso <- rep(NA_character_, length(labels))
  iso[!other] <- tolower(countrycode::countrycode(
    labels[!other], "country.name", "iso2c",
    custom_match = c(USA = "US", UK = "GB"), warn = FALSE
  ))
  dplyr::case_when(
    labels == "Other" ~ "*Other*",
    labels == "Countries at <2%" ~ "Countries at &lt;2%",
    other ~ sub("^Other \\((.*)\\)$", "*Other*<br>(\\1)", gsub("<", "&lt;", labels)),
    is.na(iso) ~ display_labels,
    TRUE ~ sprintf("%s %s", display_labels, flag_tag(iso, height, width))
  )
}

# Same grouping as the reduced combined figure below: countries with less than
# 2% of respondents are pooled into Other.
country_grouped <- country %>%
  mutate(country_work = as.character(country_work)) %>%
  mutate(country_work = if_else(
    percent_score < 2 | country_work == "Other", "Countries at <2%", country_work
  )) %>%
  group_by(country_work) %>%
  summarise(Freq = sum(Freq), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(percent_score = Freq / sum(Freq) * 100)

make_geography_plot(country_grouped, country_work, NULL) +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = flag_label) +
  theme(axis.text.y = ggtext::element_markdown(size = 20, lineheight = 0.7))
```

### All countries

```{r}
#| cache: false
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 5.7
# The section heading is the title (Wilke ch. 22), so no in-figure title.
# Countries whose individual percentage would round to 1% are split into rows
# for one and two respondents. Each bar shows its row's combined share.
country_counts_all <- country_responses %>%
  count(country_work) %>%
  mutate(
    percent_score = n / nrow(country_responses) * 100,
    displayed_percent = round(percent_score)
  )
small_countries <- country_counts_all %>%
  filter(displayed_percent == 1) %>%
  arrange(country_work) %>%
  group_by(n) %>%
  mutate(
    group_percent = sum(percent_score),
    flag_index = row_number()
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(iso = tolower(countrycode::countrycode(
    country_work, "country.name", "iso2c", warn = FALSE
  )))
# One flag per text box at even spacing (gridtext ignores spaces between images).
small_country_flags <- small_countries %>%
  transmute(
    x = group_percent + 3.5 + 1.2 * (flag_index - 1),
    y = if_else(
      n == 1,
      "1 respondent",
      "2 respondents"
    ),
    label = flag_tag(iso)
  )
country_all <- country_counts_all %>%
  mutate(country_work = case_when(
    displayed_percent == 1 & n == 1 ~ "1 respondent",
    displayed_percent == 1 ~ "2 respondents",
    TRUE ~ country_work
  )) %>%
  group_by(country_work) %>%
  summarise(
    Freq = sum(n),
    percent_score = sum(percent_score),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

small_group_percentages <- small_countries %>%
  distinct(group_percent) %>%
  pull(group_percent)

make_geography_plot(country_all, country_work, NULL,
                    respondent_total = nrow(country_responses),
                    percent_formatter = \(x) if_else(
                      x %in% small_group_percentages,
                      sprintf("%.1f%%", x),
                      paste0(round(x), "%")
                    )) +
  ggtext::geom_richtext(
    data = small_country_flags,
    aes(x, y, label = label),
    inherit.aes = FALSE, fill = NA, label.colour = NA,
    label.padding = grid::unit(0, "pt")
  ) +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = flag_label) +
  theme(axis.text.y = ggtext::element_markdown(size = 20, lineheight = 0.7))
```

### Map of participants by country

```{r country-count-map}
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 6.2
#| out-width: 100%
#| fig-alt: "World map of participant counts by country of work in Equal Earth projection, with a binned legend. Darker blue indicates more participants; light grey indicates none."

country_counts <- country_responses |>
  mutate(
    map_region = case_when(
      country_work == "United Kingdom" ~ "UK",
      country_work == "Czechia" ~ "Czech Republic",
      country_work == "T\u00fcrkiye" ~ "Turkey",
      TRUE ~ country_work
    )
  ) |>
  count(map_region, name = "participants")

# Clip polygons at the antimeridian so that no country (e.g., Russia, Fiji)
# is drawn as a band stretched across the whole map after projection.
world_map <- ggplot2::map_data("world", wrap = c(-180, 180)) |>
  filter(region != "Antarctica")

unmapped_countries <- country_counts |>
  anti_join(distinct(world_map, region), by = c("map_region" = "region"))
if (nrow(unmapped_countries) > 0) {
  stop("Countries missing from the map: ",
       paste(unmapped_countries$map_region, collapse = ", "))
}

# Equal Earth projection (Šavrič, Patterson & Jenny, 2018): an equal-area
# pseudocylindrical projection, so country areas are not inflated toward the
# poles as in Mercator.
project_equal_earth <- function(lon, lat) {
  a1 <- 1.340264
  a2 <- -0.081106
  a3 <- 0.000893
  a4 <- 0.003796
  lambda <- lon * pi / 180
  theta <- asin(sqrt(3) / 2 * sin(lat * pi / 180))
  tibble::tibble(
    x = 2 * sqrt(3) * lambda * cos(theta) /
      (3 * (9 * a4 * theta^8 + 7 * a3 * theta^6 + 3 * a2 * theta^2 + a1)),
    y = a4 * theta^9 + a3 * theta^7 + a2 * theta^3 + a1 * theta
  )
}

# Binned sequential scale: grey for no participants, then light-to-dark blue.
count_breaks <- c(0, 1, 3, 6, 12, Inf)
count_labels <- c("0", "1", "2–3", "4–6", "7–12", "13+")
count_colors <- c(
  "#E3E3E3", "#C6DBEF", "#9ECAE1", "#6BAED6", "#3182BD", "#08519C"
)
names(count_colors) <- count_labels

world_map <- world_map |>
  left_join(country_counts, by = c("region" = "map_region")) |>
  mutate(
    participants = coalesce(participants, 0L),
    count_bin = cut(
      participants,
      breaks = c(-Inf, count_breaks),
      labels = count_labels,
      right = TRUE
    )
  ) |>
  bind_cols(project_equal_earth(world_map$long, world_map$lat))

country_count_map <- ggplot(world_map, aes(x, y, group = group)) +
  geom_polygon(
    aes(fill = count_bin),
    colour = "white",
    linewidth = 0.15
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    "Participants",
    values = count_colors,
    breaks = count_labels,
    drop = FALSE,
    guide = guide_legend(
      nrow = 1,
      title.position = "top",
      title.hjust = 0.5,
      label.position = "bottom",
      keywidth = grid::unit(3.2, "lines"),
      keyheight = grid::unit(0.9, "lines")
    )
  ) +
  coord_fixed(expand = FALSE) +
  labs(
    title = "Participants by country of work",
    caption = paste0(
      "N = ", sum(country_counts$participants),
      " respondents with a country of work; ",
      n_distinct(country_counts$map_region), " countries.",
      " Equal Earth projection."
    )
  ) +
  theme_void(base_family = "Lato", base_size = 15) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 20, hjust = 0.5),
    plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0, size = 11, colour = "grey30"),
    plot.margin = margin(8, 8, 8, 8),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 13),
    legend.key.spacing.x = grid::unit(0, "pt"),
    legend.key = element_rect(colour = NA)
  )

country_count_map

ggsave_st(
  project_path("figures", "country_work_participant_map.png"),
  country_count_map,
  width = 12,
  height = 6.2,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 180,
  device = ragg::agg_png,
  bg = "white"
)
```

```{r software-reduced-data}
#| cache: false
# Same grouping as the reduced combined figure below: tools chosen by fewer
# than 4% of respondents, and "Other", are pooled; a respondent who chose
# several of them is counted once.
software_reduced_other_items <- software %>%
  filter(Freq > 0, percent_score < 4 | software == "Other") %>%
  pull(item)

software_reduced <- software %>%
  filter(Freq > 0, percent_score >= 4, software != "Other") %>%
  bind_rows(
    data %>%
      select(ID, all_of(software_reduced_other_items)) %>%
      pivot_longer(-ID, names_to = "item", values_to = "response") %>%
      group_by(ID) %>%
      summarise(selected = any(response == "Checked", na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
      summarise(Freq = sum(selected)) %>%
      mutate(
        item = NA_character_,
        software = "Other (each <4%)",
        percent_score = Freq / n_total * 100
      )
  ) %>%
  # Other last, the rest by share
  mutate(order = if_else(software == "Other (each <4%)", -Inf, percent_score))

software_reduced_plot <- function(plot_data, label_column = "software") {
  ggplot(
    plot_data,
    aes(percent_score, forcats::fct_reorder(.data[[label_column]], order))
  ) +
    geom_col(width = 0.7, fill = "#6BAED6") +
    geom_text(aes(label = paste0(round(percent_score), "%")),
              hjust = -0.15, size = 8) +  # ~23 pt, matches the 20 pt axis text in the larger figure
    scale_x_continuous(
      "Percent of respondents",
      labels = \(x) paste0(x, "%"),
      sec.axis = sec_axis(~ . * n_total / 100, name = "Number of respondents"),
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.10))
    ) +
    labs(y = NULL) +  # section heading is the title (Wilke ch. 22)
    coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
    theme_classic(base_family = "Lato", base_size = 20) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 22),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 20),
      axis.ticks.y = element_blank()
    )
}
```

### Grouped with logos (experiment)

```{r software-reduced-logos}
#| cache: false
#| fig-cap: '\* Survey answer "My own code in …" for the language shown.'
#| fig-width: 11
#| fig-height: 7
# Experiment: tool branding in the axis labels. Where a tool has its own
# lettering, only the lettering is used (no icon); otherwise logo + name. Tools
# without a usable logo stay text. Logo sources: figures/software_logos/SOURCES.md
# gridtext places images on the text baseline and cannot lower them, so text
# next to a logo is raised instead: <sup> lifts it by half the font ascent and
# the style attribute restores the full 20 pt size. Logos beside text use
# logo_text_height so their middle lines up with the raised text.
logo_text_height <- 32
logo <- function(file, height = logo_text_height) {
  sprintf(
    "<img src='%s' height='%d'/>",
    project_path("figures", "software_logos", file),
    height
  )
}
# One <sup> lifts about 7 pt; two nested lifts bring the text to the logo middle.
# Branded lettering with descenders (python): one lift aligns the baselines.
lift <- function(text) sprintf("<sup style='font-size:20pt'>%s</sup>", text)
mid <- function(text) {
  sprintf("<sup style='font-size:20pt'><sup style='font-size:20pt'>%s</sup></sup>", text)
}

# Equal letter size across all lettering: cap height (all-caps words) or
# ascender height (mixed words), measured per image so each is ~15 pt. "*" = "My own code in ...", explained in the caption.
star <- "<sup style='font-size:24pt'>*</sup>"  # 'My own code in', see caption
software_logo_labels <- c(
  "EEGLAB" = logo("eeglab_text.png", 21),
  "MNE-Python" = logo("mne.png", 16),
  "FieldTrip" = logo("fieldtrip_text.png", 20),
  "ERPLAB" = logo("erplab_text.png", 21),
  "ggplot" = logo("ggplot2_text.png", 21),
  "SPM" = logo("spm_text.png", 16),
  "Brain Vision Analyser" = logo("brainvision_analyzer_text.png", 32),
  "Brainstorm" = logo("brainstorm_text.png", 18),
  "LIMO" = logo("limo_text.png", 17),
  "My own code in MATLAB" = paste0(star, logo("matlab_text.png", 17)),
  "My own code in Python" = paste0(star, logo("python_text.png", 21)),
  "My own code in R" = paste0(star, logo("r.png", 18)),
  "Other (each <4%)" = "*Other*<br>(each &lt;4%)"
)

software_reduced %>%
  mutate(
    label = coalesce(unname(software_logo_labels[software]), software)
  ) %>%
  software_reduced_plot("label") +
  theme(axis.text.y = ggtext::element_markdown(size = 20, lineheight = 0.7))
```

## Combined figures

```{r participant-characteristics-figure}
#| cache: false
#| fig-width: 15
#| fig-height: 10

make_characteristic_plot <- function(
  plot_data,
  label_column,
  title,
  bar_width = 0.7,
  label_size = 20
) {
  plot_data <- plot_data %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[label_column]])) %>%
    mutate(
      display_label = forcats::fct_reorder(
        factor(.data[[label_column]]),
        other_last(.data[[label_column]], percent_score)
      )
    )

  ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = percent_score, y = display_label)) +
    geom_col(width = bar_width, fill = "#6BAED6") +
    geom_text(
      aes(label = paste0(round(percent_score), "%")),
      hjust = -0.15,
      size = 8
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      limits = c(0, 100),
      breaks = seq(0, 100, 25),
      labels = \(x) paste0(x, "%"),
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))
    ) +
    scale_y_discrete(labels = format_category_labels) +
    labs(title = title, x = "Percent of respondents", y = NULL) +
    coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
    theme_classic(base_family = "Lato", base_size = 20) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 26),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 20),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 20),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = label_size),
      axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
      plot.margin = margin(8, 20, 8, 8)
    )
}

experience_combined <- data %>%
  filter(!is.na(A001), A001 != "") %>%
  count(level = A001, name = "Freq") %>%
  mutate(percent_score = Freq / sum(Freq) * 100)

country_combined <- country %>%
  transmute(
    country_work = as.character(country_work),
    Freq,
    percent_score
  )

field_combined <- field %>%
  filter(!is.na(field), field != "")

software_combined <- software %>%
  filter(Freq > 0, !is.na(software), software != "")

p_experience <- make_characteristic_plot(
  experience_combined,
  "level",
  "Self-assessed level"
)
p_country <- make_characteristic_plot(
  country_combined,
  "country_work",
  "Country of work"
)
p_field <- make_characteristic_plot(
  field_combined,
  "field",
  "Research field"
)
p_software <- make_characteristic_plot(
  software_combined,
  "software",
  "Software used"
)

participant_characteristics_figure <-
  (p_experience + p_field) /
  (p_country + p_software) +
  plot_layout(heights = c(0.65, 1.35)) +
  plot_annotation(
    tag_levels = "A",
    caption = paste0(
      "Bars show percentages of respondents with valid responses. ",
      "Multiple software selections were permitted."
    ),
    theme = theme(
      plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18),
      plot.caption = element_text(
        hjust = 0.5,
        face = "italic",
        family = "Lato",
        size = 18
      )
    )
  )

participant_characteristics_figure

if (isTRUE(params$export_artifacts)) {
  ggsave_st(
    project_path("figures", "participant_characteristics_figure.png"),
    participant_characteristics_figure,
    width = 15,
    height = 13,
    units = "in",
    dpi = 180,
    device = ragg::agg_png,
    bg = "white"
  )
}
```

### Reduced figure

```{r participant-characteristics-figure-over-3-percent}
#| cache: false
#| fig-width: 15
#| fig-height: 9

country_over_3 <- country_combined %>%
  mutate(
    country_work = if_else(
      percent_score < 2,
      "Other",
      country_work
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(country_work) %>%
  summarise(Freq = sum(Freq), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(
    percent_score = Freq / sum(Freq) * 100,
    country_work = if_else(
      country_work == "Other",
      "Other\n(each <2%)",
      country_work
    )
  )

software_other_items <- software_combined %>%
  filter(percent_score < 4 | software == "Other") %>%
  pull(item)

# Count each respondent once in Other even if they selected more than one
# software category that is being grouped.
software_other <- data %>%
  select(ID, all_of(software_other_items)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    -ID,
    names_to = "item",
    values_to = "response"
  ) %>%
  group_by(ID) %>%
  summarise(
    selected_other = any(response == "Checked", na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  summarise(Freq = sum(selected_other)) %>%
  mutate(
    item = NA_character_,
    software = "Other\n(each <4%)",
    percent_score = Freq / n_total * 100
  )

software_over_3 <- software_combined %>%
  filter(percent_score >= 4, software != "Other") %>%
  bind_rows(software_other)

p_country_over_3 <- make_characteristic_plot(
  country_over_3,
  "country_work",
  "Country of work",
  label_size = 24
) +
  scale_y_discrete(
    labels = \(labels) labels %>%
      stringr::str_replace_all("<", "&lt;") %>%
      stringr::str_replace("^Other\\n", "*Other*<br>")
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = ggtext::element_markdown(
      size = 24,
      lineheight = 0.75
    )
  )

p_software_over_3 <- make_characteristic_plot(
  software_over_3,
  "software",
  "Software used"
) +
  scale_y_discrete(
    labels = \(labels) labels %>%
      stringr::str_replace_all("<", "&lt;") %>%
      stringr::str_replace("^Other\\n", "*Other*<br>")
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = ggtext::element_markdown(
      size = 20,
      lineheight = 0.75
    )
  )

participant_characteristics_over_3_figure <-
  (p_experience + p_field) /
  (p_country_over_3 + p_software_over_3) +
  plot_layout(heights = c(0.65, 1.35)) +
  plot_annotation(
    tag_levels = "A",
    caption = paste0(
      "Multiple software selections were permitted in D."
    ),
    theme = theme(
      plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18),
      plot.caption = element_text(
        hjust = 0.5,
        face = "italic",
        family = "Lato",
        size = 18
      )
    )
  )

participant_characteristics_over_3_figure

if (isTRUE(params$export_artifacts)) {
  ggsave_st(
    project_path("figures", "participant_characteristics_over_3_figure.png"),
    participant_characteristics_over_3_figure,
    width = 15,
    height = 13,
    units = "in",
    dpi = 180,
    device = ragg::agg_png,
    bg = "white"
  )
}
```

### Figure with icons

```{r participant-characteristics-icons-figure}
#| cache: false
#| fig-width: 15
#| fig-height: 8
#| fig-cap: 'Flags indicate country of work, not nationality. Multiple software selections were permitted. An asterisk denotes the survey answer "My own code in …".'

country_icon_labels <- function(labels) {
  labels <- as.character(labels)
  is_other <- startsWith(labels, "Other")
  country_names <- sub("\\n.*$", "", labels)
  formatted <- flag_label(country_names, height = 13, width = 21)
  formatted[is_other] <- "*Other*<br>(each &lt;2%)"
  formatted
}

software_icon_labels <- function(labels) {
  labels <- as.character(labels)
  is_other <- startsWith(labels, "Other")
  software_names <- sub("\\n.*$", "", labels)
  formatted <- coalesce(
    unname(software_logo_labels[software_names]),
    software_names
  )
  formatted[is_other] <- "*Other*<br>(each &lt;4%)"
  formatted
}

make_icon_dot_plot <- function(
  plot_data,
  label_column,
  title,
  label_function
) {
  plot_data <- plot_data %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[label_column]])) %>%
    mutate(display_label = forcats::fct_reorder(
      factor(.data[[label_column]]),
      other_last(.data[[label_column]], percent_score)
    ))

  ggplot(plot_data, aes(percent_score, display_label)) +
    geom_segment(
      aes(x = 0, xend = percent_score, yend = display_label),
      colour = "#C6DDEB",
      linewidth = 1.2
    ) +
    geom_point(size = 5, colour = "#3182BD") +
    geom_text(
      aes(label = paste0(round(percent_score), "%")),
      hjust = -0.3,
      size = 6
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      limits = c(0, 70),
      breaks = c(0, 20, 40, 60),
      labels = \(x) paste0(x, "%"),
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))
    ) +
    scale_y_discrete(labels = label_function) +
    labs(title = title, x = "Percent of respondents", y = NULL) +
    coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
    theme_classic(base_family = "Lato", base_size = 20) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 26),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 18),
      axis.text.y = ggtext::element_markdown(size = 18, lineheight = 0.75),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 20),
      axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
      plot.margin = margin(8, 24, 8, 8)
    )
}

p_country_icons <- make_icon_dot_plot(
  country_over_3,
  "country_work",
  "Country of work",
  country_icon_labels
)

p_software_icons <- make_icon_dot_plot(
  software_over_3,
  "software",
  "Software used",
  software_icon_labels
)

participant_characteristics_icons_figure <-
  p_country_icons + p_software_icons +
  plot_layout(widths = c(0.95, 1.05)) +
  plot_annotation(
    tag_levels = "A",
    theme = theme(plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18))
  )

participant_characteristics_icons_figure

if (isTRUE(params$export_artifacts)) {
  ggsave_st(
    project_path("figures", "participant_characteristics_icons_figure.png"),
    participant_characteristics_icons_figure,
    width = 15,
    height = 8,
    units = "in",
    dpi = 180,
    device = ragg::agg_png,
    bg = "white"
  )
}
```
